description: Shared case table for the «Huecos de hoy» engine (#992 S2, Apple round). fixedNow is interpreted in the DEVICE local timezone: suites must build it from these local components (2026-11-27 is a Friday). Events are minute offsets from the START OF THE FIXED DAY (isAllDay marks an all-day event, which occupies the whole day). expectedGaps are {startMin, endMin} minute offsets from the start of the fixed day, in display order (by start). Semantics: gaps run strictly BETWEEN merged busy intervals — nothing before the first busy block or after the last one counts (an empty or single-event day has NO gaps, per issue S1); the window starts at max(now, day start), so gaps are truncated to it and dropped when the remainder is under the 25-minute minimum; overlapping and touching events merge into one busy block; an all-day event makes the whole day busy. At most 3 gaps are returned: the 3 LONGEST, then ordered by start.

cases.name: one clean gap between two meetings, usable part starts at now
a 20-minute gap is below the minimum and dropped
overlapping events merge into one busy block
touching events leave nothing between them
an all-day event occupies the whole day
a past gap is truncated to now and survives when still long enough
a gap that ends before now is gone
an empty day has no gaps (issue S1)
a single busy block leaves nothing between
an event fully contained in another merges silently
more than 3 gaps after now: the 3 longest win, ordered by start (gaps of 50/70/55/45)
a contained event inside an all-day day changes nothing
a 24-minute gap floors below the minimum
an exactly-25-minute gap survives (truncated to now)
